Subject: Vendor portal sync + CAIQ/SIG mapping request

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acme Health is moving into procurement and the security team asked if we can get our SIG/CAIQ artifacts staged in a portal. We have about 320 SIG rows across internal apps and a canonical CAIQ file. Two asks from our end:

1) Can you ingest a partial export first (we'll send the SIG CSV and CAIQ mapping) so Acme's intake team can validate taxonomy before a full upload?
2) What retention (TTL) strategy does Redwood use for vendor evidence that we upload to Vendr/Whistic/OneTrust during onboarding? The security team wants a written plan for evidence lifecycle (staging, rotation cadence, deletion after contract end).

Attaching a small sample of the SIG export and the CAIQ mapping sheet so you can see the format. We'll also need a short window where Acme can review before anything becomes part of the live profile.

Files attached: acme_sig_inventory.csv, caiq-mapping-template.xlsx

Can you confirm next steps and a rough timeline?

Best,
Priya Gupta
Senior Security Program Manager
Acme Health

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal sync + CAIQ/SIG mapping request

Hi Priya — really appreciate the sample files, they look clean. Quick outline from our side so we're aligned: 

- Phase 1 (staging ingest, 2 business days): We ingest your sample into a sandbox Vendr profile, generate a column->SIG mapping report and flag mismatches. That gives Acme a chance to confirm taxonomy without affecting the live profile.
- Phase 2 (validation window, 3 business days): Acme reviews flagged items in the sandbox; we iterate until mappings are agreed.
- Phase 3 (promotion & TTL policy applied): After sign-off we promote the curated artifacts to the live profile. Evidence TTLs will be applied per-document class (expiring credentials, screenshots, policy docs).

TTL proposal (default unless you request changes):
- Short-lived artifacts (creds, certs): 90 days
- Operational artifacts (runbooks, config snapshots): 12 months
- Policies and attestation docs (SOC2 reports, contracts): 36 months

We can make exceptions for regulated artifacts; if Acme wants a longer retention window we can record that in the profile metadata and set an override. All evidence uploads are versioned; we keep a provenance record for audits.

Next steps: I'll run the sample through the sandbox tonight and share the mapping report tomorrow morning. Marissa — can you take point on the sandbox ingest? Ben/Karthik, we'll need the Vendr service account info and the minimal access list so we can push drafts.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Manager, Security Onboarding
Redwood Inference
